function: Joint communication and sensing beamforming at cooperating BSs: sum-rate maximization under per-BS power and target-position error bound (SPEB) constraints (p. 5).
system: Cooperative ISAC with 3 BSs, each a 4x4 UPA (16 antennas), 5 single-antenna users, one sensing target, 28 GHz; no RIS (p. 9).
method: Link-heterogeneous graph neural network with graph attention, 9 GNN plus 2 fully connected layers, trained unsupervised with a penalty-based loss, no labels (pp. 7-9).
data_channel: DeepMIMO outdoor scenario O1 at 28 GHz (BSs 1-3) for communication channels; sensing links use the paper's own LoS echo model; 4,000 training samples (pp. 3-4, 9).
test_conditions: Same DeepMIMO O1 scene, 3 BSs, 5 users, one target throughout; only transmit power (12-24 dBm), SNR (0-30 dB) and position error (0-7 m) are swept (pp. 9-11).
baselines: Non-learned: SRW (SCA-based iterative optimization). Learned: Homo GNN and naive CNN, trained the same way; LHGNN without attention is an ablation (pp. 9-10).
metrics: Achievable sum rate (bps/Hz) versus transmit power, SNR and position error; SPEB (m^2) as sensing accuracy (pp. 9-11, Figs. 7-10).
openness: No code or data link; uses the public DeepMIMO O1 scenario (ref. [26]) (p. 9).
q1_support: p. 9: "outdoor scenario from the DeepMIMO dataset [26] to generate the required data". DeepMIMO ray tracing supplies the communication channels; the sensing echo channel is the paper's own LoS model (pp. 3-4).
q2_support: p. 9: "The number of BSs is set to N = 3" and K = 5 users in one fixed scene; p. 10: "the impact of different levels of channel estimation error is evaluated". Only SNR and position-error sweeps; no new scenario, user count or BS count is tested.
q3_support: p. 9: "an iterative algorithm based on SCA is designed to complete the joint beamforming matrix design" (SRW, non-learned); p. 9: "convolutional neural networks (CNN) are adopted to extract features" (naive CNN, learned); p. 10: LHGNN beats the others in rate (Fig. 7) and SPEB (Fig. 8).
q4_support: p. 9: "The output dimensions of features for different GNN hidden layers are as follows" lists layer widths only. No parameter count, FLOPs, runtime or complexity order of LHGNN appears; p. 2: "low inference complexity" is a generic claim about deep learning.
q5_support: p. 9: "outdoor scenario from the DeepMIMO dataset [26]", a public ray-tracing dataset used for training and testing. No code link is given.
notes: Included, area 5: beamforming in a cooperative ISAC system; localization enters only as the SPEB constraint, not as the learned function. DeepMIMO supplies the communication CSI, so q1 and q5 rest on it. Naive CNN carries the learned baseline of q3; Homo GNN and LHGNN without attention are variants of the proposed method. PDF is the arXiv v1 preprint; its title matches the Crossref title of the DOI.
